notes.title: CottontailVA Joins VTumbler!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44790642/d5dff79f191cc78e115e9cfb56f4aff31d3f21ca.png

We're delighted to announce the fifth VTuber to join the VTumbler roster is the talented voice actor and VTuber, CottontailVA!

She'll be available for free alongside FeFe, Chibidoki, Fream, and obkatiekat in the base game at launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744110/VTumbler/

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44790642/fc47063f9519f4b3fecf8ec5e818711a8d86ae18.png

We're excited to announce that the VTumbler demo is now live and ready to play! Plus, VTumbler is being showcased in the Steam Next Fest!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744110/VTumbler/

[previewyoutube=E8swbZ9HDTg;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to the demo, we’ve launched a Kickstarter for VTumbler, including amazing rewards! Click here to check it out and consider supporting it!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44790642/21d58716369a8f66af6a51513997c362c252d72c.png

Don't forget to check out the brand new website for VTumbler that recently opened to the public and can be viewed here.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44790642/a28c5d00031ab5fb5a413f71c039c7a543b02a33.png
